name: Takatsuki Hidenori
source:
"I believe that the dead should be given the utmost respect, regardless of religion or non-religion."

Minazuki's senior at work and his boss. He is friendly and has a light-hearted demeanor at first glance, but he is enthusiastic and excellent at his work, and is highly regarded at the company.

He has a caring, older brother-like personality and helps out Minazuki in the areas he's weak in.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1712864842099662853]
